question: Is Elsa good at holding her liquor? My mental image of her seems like she would be.
answer: She might be good at it, but I don't have a mental image of her drinking because she likes it. Despite appearances, I think she liked milk and such. So when they gave her milk instead of alcohol at the loot house, she didn't get angry. There, she probably said "Milk, please", wouldn't you think?
